title: CrowdStrike fiscal Q1 2027 results exhibit
excerpt: Fiscal Q1 revenue grew 26% to USD 1.386 billion, ending ARR grew 24% to USD 5.51 billion and free cash flow was USD 468.5 million.
summary: The unchanged SEC-hosted fiscal Q1 results exhibit remains the latest retained earnings evidence and continues to support the ARR-growth, module-adoption, revenue-guidance and free-cash-flow assumptions.
